clusters.agenda_text: Merck and Moderna reports that their cancer vaccine candidate showed positive results in their late-stage trial in preventing a recurrence of melanoma, including in high-risk patients
clusters.headline: Moderna and Merck cancer vaccine shows positive results in melanoma trial
clusters.summary: A personalized cancer vaccine developed by Moderna and Merck has demonstrated promising results in late-stage clinical trials for melanoma, showing potential in reducing the risk of cancer recurrence. The positive data from the trial led to a significant surge in Moderna's share price, reflecting investor confidence in the therapeutic approach. The vaccine, which uses messenger RNA technology tailored to individual patients, represents a breakthrough in personalized cancer treatment.

clusters.agenda_text: Iran says it barred two French embassy employees from returning for allegedly violating the Vienna Convention through activities supporting Iranian civil society. France says their work involved programs for civil society, students, and artists
clusters.headline: Iran bars two French embassy employees from returning
clusters.summary: Iran said it prevented two French embassy employees from re-entering the country, claiming they violated the Vienna Convention through activities supporting Iranian civil society. France stated that the employees' work involved programs for civil society, students, and artists.

clusters.agenda_text: Thai rescuers find a French tourist and his two sons alive after they spend more than 16 hours at sea when their rented jet ski capsizes off Ko Samui. The family receives medical checks and is discharged
clusters.headline: French family rescued after drifting for 16 hours off Thailand coast
clusters.summary: A French family was rescued after spending more than 16 hours adrift off the coast of Thailand, according to a report by La Vanguardia. The rescue operation brought the family to safety in waters near Thailand.

clusters.agenda_text: The Constitutional Council of France blocks a bill proposing a ban social media access for minors under the age of 15. President Emmanuel Macron orders prime minister Sebastien Lecornu to re-work the draft legislation and resubmit it to the Council
clusters.headline: France's Constitutional Council rejects minor social media ban bill
clusters.summary: France's Constitutional Council has blocked a bill that would have banned social media access for minors under 15 years old. Following this decision, President Emmanuel Macron has instructed Prime Minister Sebastian Lecornu to revise the draft legislation and resubmit it to the Council for review.
